text:
Anya: Quick design check — the legend colors on the model latency chart look fine in light mode, but in dark mode the blue+purple pair is losing contrast against gridlines. Thinking about swapping the purple for a warmer orange and slightly increasing marker weight.

Marco: Can you paste a mock? Also what's the target contrast ratio? We should aim for 4.5:1 for small UI text/legend.

Anya: Mock below. I bumped to `--palette-accent-3: #ff8a50` and increased stroke to `2px` for markers. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/mock123.png

Syd: CSS tweak I'd try:
```
--palette-accent-1: #5bc0ff; /* cold blue */
--palette-accent-2: #7a5cff; /* purple */
--palette-accent-3: #ff8a50; /* proposed orange */
.chart-legend .dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
```
That border helps outlines in dark mode.

Priya: Accessibility nit: markers + legend text together need 4.5:1 contrast. The hex `#ff8a50` against `#1b1d22` gives ~6.1:1 which is good. But chart line alpha on hover drops contrast — watch hover states.

Jamal: Product thought: keep color meaning consistent across charts (errors=red, success=green). Is orange used elsewhere? Could conflict with token-cost highlights.

Anya: Good call — we can reserve orange for 'warn' across dashboard. Maybe use `--palette-accent-4: #ffd29e` as a softer accent for this chart so it doesn't map to warn.

Marco: Also consider syntax highlighting tweaks for the console: our purple is too saturated on code tokens. Try reducing saturation and bumping background overlay for code blocks in dark mode.

Syd: Proposed diff for code block:
```
.code-block { background: rgba(12,14,18,0.86); }
.token.keyword { color: #cda9ff; opacity: 0.95; }
.token.string { color: #9fe6a0; }
```
Less neon, more legible.

Priya: Please add aria-labels to legend items: `aria-label="legend: model a latency"` — that'll help screen reader users.

colorbot: Automated contrast check — legend color #ffd29e vs bg #101114 => ratio 4.7:1 PASS. Syntax color #cda9ff vs bg #0c0e12 => ratio 3.9:1 FAIL (token.keyword small text). Recommend #bca1f7 for 4.5:1.

Anya: Ok switching keyword to `#bca1f7`. I'll update the mock and push to figma. Thanks everyone :heart: 

Marco: Quick follow-up — when you push, include a before/after gif so eng can verify transitions aren't jarring.

Syd: I'll add a tiny transition `opacity .12s linear` for marker hover so it feels snappy.

Jamal: 👍 from PMs, schedule a quick ops review if this touches core palette tokens.

Anya: Will do. Ending thread — will post PR link when ready.
